quotes.text: The finding-level score is the fraction of these findings present in the generated summary under an abbreviation- and negation-aware matcher.

parsed.rationale: The grader input is the submitted answer (problem list, summary text, rankings, question text), scored deterministically against graph-derived labels. There is no stated rationale for answer-based rather than state grading, and no validation of the grader on labelled correct and incorrect outcomes with per-class error rates.
